interpretation_guard: Do not infer D×E, choose a pair, or inspect confirmation outcomes from this six-task screen. It exists only to detect floor/ceiling and pipeline failure cheaply.
pool_gate: Proceed to the full 24-task local pair-selection pilot only if at least two of the three local models pass the per-model technical gate. Otherwise local models are an inadequate competence range and stronger/API models are required.
primary_screen_outcome: semantic success on every packaged positive testcase for the task; compile failure or any wrong case is failure
purpose: R4b local-model infrastructure/competence screen only; not scientific evidence and not model-pair selection
task_rationale: Outcome-blind subset of the already frozen pilot spanning both sources and public difficulty strata: CF <=1000 and 1500-1800; LC Easy, Medium, Hard.
